question.text: The total number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Mn</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> bonds in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>Mn</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>7</mn></msub></math> is

solution.text: The manganese heptoxide solubility properties indicate that it is a nonpolar molecular species, which is confirmed by its structure. The molecules consist of a pair of tetrahedra that share a common vertex. The vertices are occupied by oxygen atoms and at the centres of the tetrahedra are the Mn centres. The connectivity is indicated by the formula O3Mn−O−MnO3.
